newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Lehman cuts Hilton Q4 EPS.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Lehman cuts Hilton Q4 EPS.

text.p: -- Lehman analyst Joyce Minor said she was cutting her fourth quarter earnings estimate to $0.29 per share from $0.32 per share to reflect the company's "bad luck during Q4, particularly at its baccarat tables at the Las Vegas Hilton."
-- Minor said she was maintaining our buy recommendation and a $34 price target, adding that "we would use weakness related to near-term earnings revisions as a buying opportunity."
-- The stock was trading at 25-5/8, down 3/8 on the day at mid-morning Tuesday.
